title: Axis Flipkart Super Elite credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded premium shopping card with Flipkart offering elevated cashback on Flipkart and Myntra purchases, milestone benefits, and exclusive partner discounts for frequent online shoppers.

benefitRows.name: Cleartrip Flights
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this Cleartrip Flights voucher with Axis Flipkart Super Elite, log in at https://axisbankaura.poshvine.com using your registered mobile number, enter the OTP sent to your phone, select your Cleartrip Flights voucher from the benefits, and redeem it online at www.cleartrip.com.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: 15% off up to INR 500 on EazyDiner.|Minimum Order Value INR 2500
benefitRows.howToAvail: Select the restaurant to be paid on the EazyDiner app.|Enter the amount, and select the offer.|Discount will be applied and net payment will be required to be made.
